from.description: The store the operation gives the key up in: the store recorded in credentials.store when a move started, or the store that is not being recorded for a first recording.

to.description: The store the operation switches to; never equal to from.

phase.description: copying until the record is rewritten after the switch, switched from then on; between the switch of credentials.store to to and the rewrite the record still says copying.

target_held_key.description: Whether to held the integrity key the operation keeps when it started, before the first copy: the key of from for a move, since a target that holds another key is refused, and the key the sidecars verify under for a first recording. A target that holds a key while from holds none holds that key, not the key of from. The clean-up of a failed operation and the resume delete the key from to only where this is false and from holds the key.

operation.description: The operation the record drives: move copies every Token Lane entry and the key between the stores and empties the old store; first_recording is the credential-store aspect's first recording of a store, which moves the integrity key alone.

transaction_id.description: The id of the operation, issued once when the record is written and kept across a resume; the audit record of the operation carries it, so a record handed over again is recognised as the same.
